Ref: SK0COSTILLARES. Discover this spectacular brand-new loft apartment, located in one of Madrid's most sought-after areas, near the Pinar de Chamartín metro station. With quick access to the M-11, A-1, and M-30 motorways, you'll be just a 15-minute drive from the airport, making it a perfect choice for those seeking convenience and connectivity. This bright, 45 m² space is fully furnished and features an open-plan design that integrates a modern American-style kitchen with a breakfast bar, ideal for enjoying pleasant moments. The living room, equipped with a smart TV, is the perfect place to relax after a long day. The bedroom offers a double bed and a built-in wardrobe, while the spacious bathroom includes a shower and heating. The apartment also features individual air conditioning and heating, as well as a laundry area with a washer and dryer and a small office, perfect for working from home or studying. The building has a doorman throughout the day and offers amenities such as a paddle tennis court, tennis court, and a refreshing communal pool to enjoy during the summer months. This apartment is suitable for people with reduced mobility and is available for temporary stays of up to 11 months. Electricity, water, and Wi-Fi are included in the price. It also comes with kitchenware, linens, and towels, making your move even easier. COME AND VISIT AND ENJOY THE UTILITIES INCLUDED IN THE PRICE! A 2-month security deposit is required, and creditworthiness will be assessed.
